title: Your lap timer tells you nothing

scenes.voice: Your lap timer says you were slow. It never says where, or what to change.
While you drive, TRACE shows the next corner, how tight it is, and a countdown. Switch on the voice, and it just says: brake hard.
In the pits, it shows the three corners where you are losing the most. Change one thing, not ten.
After the session, every corner, lap by lap, against your own best clean lap. No guessing.
Follow TRACE to be first when it launches.

caption: Live, in the pits, and after the session. Track days only.
